issues.span: Having employed sticks and the like as the actual instruments, if one feels anger at the one who throws them
issues.evidence: དབྱུག་པ་ལ་སོགས་དངོས་བཀོལ་ཏེ། གལ་ཏེ་འཕེན་པ་ལ་ཁྲོ་ན། The one who employs (བཀོལ) the sticks is the thrower (bo-shenga 6-41: 'དབྱུག་པ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་དངོས་པོ་རྣམས་བཀོལ་ཏེ་ལུས་ལ་བརྡེག་པ་ན། གལ་ཏེ་འཕེན་པ་པོ་ཉིད་ལ་ཁྲོ་ན'; bo-kunpal 6-41). In the English the participle 'Having employed' has the grammatical subject 'one' (the angry victim), so it reads as if the victim employed the sticks.
issues.fix: Since he employs sticks and the like as the actual instruments, if one feels anger at the one who throws them,
